integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically from the published update and line search. The bundled numerical replay is only a finite consistency check and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact theoretical I-LMM on the scalar boundary-only system \(F(x)=x^2\); no claim is made for systems possessing strict feasible points.
The result concerns exact zero-residual termination; practical positive tolerances can stop after a finite number of iterations.
The finding does not contradict the source accumulation-point theorem because the auxiliary slack coordinate has no finite accumulation point.
title: Boundary-only feasibility forces slack escape in exponential-slack I-LMM
